translations.web: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,
translations.bsb: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for Him,
translations.kjv: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways;
translations.asv: Yea and thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Most High: For thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to make ready his ways;
